name: Pending Start Date Change Then Withdrawal
description: FLP-2089. SLD POSTs a draft apprenticeship, Commitments approves it, then SLD PUTs a new StartDate (2025-09-13) which the local Approvals stub answers EmployerApprovalRequested (pending). Earnings is still updated with the new start date and its episode is flagged FurtherApprovalNeeded, matching Learning. SLD then PUTs a withdrawal while the start date change is still pending. The withdrawal reaches Earnings (the outer API no longer holds it back, as it did under FLP-2107), and both flags stay set. Bus messages are asserted from EventHub's ReceivedEvents, so EventHub must be running locally (the storybook checks before running): the expected events are waited for, then the ones that must not appear are checked.

steps.name: SLD Changes the Start Date (Approvals answers pending)
Capture the Earnings Start Date While the Change Is Pending
SLD Withdraws the Learner (start date change still pending)

assertions.name: Earnings took the new start date while the change was pending
Learning episode still needs further approval after the withdrawal
Earnings episode still needs further approval after the withdrawal
Withdrawal reaches Earnings while the start date is awaiting approval
Pending start date has reached the Earnings price
Pending start date has reached the Earnings period in learning
Payments are withheld once, on the start date change, and the withdrawal reaches Approvals
No change is echoed to Approvals and no on-programme payments are released
